name: Dragon Flag
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the bench behind your head. Raise your legs and hips so your body is a straight line resting on your upper back and shoulders.
Keeping your body rigid from shoulders to toes, slowly lower your legs and torso toward the bench without bending at the hips.
Stop just above the bench and reverse the motion, lifting back up using your core.
This is an advanced move. Start with bent knees or only the lowering phase, and keep your neck relaxed.
image_prompt_scene: Lying on a bench gripping behind the head, with the body rigid and raised on the shoulders.
